_metadata.description: Ground truth relevance labels for evaluating the resume ranking system.
_metadata.label_status: ALL 30 labels VERIFIED after expert label review.
instructions: Review each candidate's relevance label against the job description.
Adjust the 'relevance' field (0-3) based on YOUR human judgment.
The evaluation framework will warn if unverified labels remain.

relevance_scale.0: Not relevant - wrong domain, no skill overlap
relevance_scale.1: Marginally relevant - some transferable skills, weak fit
relevance_scale.2: Relevant - good skill match, reasonable experience
relevance_scale.3: Highly relevant - strong match, ideal candidate

evaluations.job_description_text:
We are hiring a Senior Backend Python Developer to join our engineering team. The ideal candidate has 4+ years of experience building scalable REST APIs and microservices using Python. You will design and implement high-throughput backend services, optimize database queries, and collaborate with frontend teams.

Required Skills:
- Python (advanced), FastAPI or Django
- PostgreSQL, Redis
- Docker, Kubernetes
- REST API design, microservices architecture
- Git, CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins/GitHub Actions)
- Unit testing with pytest

Nice to Have:
- AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda)
- Message queues (RabbitMQ, Kafka)
- GraphQL
- Experience with agile/scrum methodologies

Experience: 4+ years in backend software development.
evaluations.experience_requirements: 4+ years of backend development experience with Python web frameworks and microservices
